messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT: Increased 5xx and serving node restarts in us-east-1. Symptoms: CUDA errors, container restarts, and node network flaps. Paging on-call.

alice_m (oncall): Ack. I'm looking now. seeing spike in 5xx from /v1/generate, 95th latency jumped to ~2.8s -> 4.2s. Tracing shows repeated retries to the same node pool.

alice_m (oncall): @ben_s can you check infra telemetry for RDMA/IB link events? I’m seeing `CUDA error: cuCtxDestroy` logs in runtime pods before OOMs.

ben_s (infra): On it. initial glance at host logs shows `mlx5_core: Port 1 link down` events across 3 hosts in the same rack. Flow-control errors and packet retransmit counters increasing.

carmen (runtime): Containers report `OOMKilled` and `CUDA driver reset detected` right before restart. Could be kernel/driver causing GPU resets rather than model memory growth.

leo_sre: Which node names? I can cordon/drain if needed.

ben_s (infra): Affected nodes: ib-node-11/12/13. All are on the same IB switch. `ibstat` shows ports flapping, `dmesg` dump attached in logs: "mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: Port 1 link down" repeated.

alice_m (oncall): Immediate mitigation idea: route traffic away from that node pool to non-RDMA fallback pool. Can we switch routing in the serving router? @carmen

carmen (runtime): Yes we have a non-rdma compatible runtime variant. I can push a traffic rule to route new requests to fallback pool and set canary disable on the RDMA pool. Running command now: 
```
redwood route set --from pool/rtd-rdma --to pool/rtd-cpu-fallback --weight 100
```

carmen (runtime): Done. New requests should bypass RDMA pool. Existing inflight may still hit flapping nodes for a bit.

devex_kitty: Noted customer impact on /v1/chat streaming too — a few customers reported truncated streams.

tim_sales: Which customers impacted? Need to alert CS for those on Dedicated infra.

alice_m (oncall): Early list: Acme Analytics (dedicated in us-east-1), FinanceApp (high qps), and several smaller PLG users. Error rate ~4.8% cluster-wide; for Acme Analytics it's ~12%.

ops_pager: Paging on-call infra (ben_s) — are we escalating to vendor support for NIC/firmware?

ben_s (infra): Filing with NIC vendor now. But immediate containment: cordon ib-node-11/12/13 and drain pods. Running:
```
kubectl cordon ib-node-11 ib-node-12 ib-node-13
kubectl drain ib-node-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

ben_s (infra): Drains started. Pods are rescheduling to fallback pool. Noticing slow reschedules because some nodes are saturated; spinning up 4 extra fallback nodes (m-type) now.

alice_m (oncall): Can we temporarily disable RDMA transports in the runtime to avoid driver calls that trigger GPU reset? Any env flag?

carmen (runtime): There's an env `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_RDMA_ENABLED=false` we can set on the daemonset. Rolling that to the RDMA pool but we've already rerouted traffic. I'll also patch the runtime to ignore RDMA devices to be safe.

leo_sre: Confirming traffic to fallback reduced 5xx to ~0.6% in last 3 min. Latency back to ~1.2s p95. Good signal.

ben_s (infra): NIC vendor responded: asked for firmware logs and MLX core dumps. They suspect aggressive link training causing port flaps under high packet rates. They're recommending firmware downgrade or switch config change; need out-of-band maintenance.

alice_m (oncall): Customer comms: DevEx / CS standby to prepare message for Acme Analytics and FinanceApp. Who wants to own the initial heads-up? @devex_kitty

devex_kitty: I'll draft a short heads-up: "We're experiencing network hardware issues affecting inference in us-east-1; we've routed traffic to a safe fallback pool and we're monitoring. No model data was exposed; some requests may have failed." Will share with CS.

tim_sales: Please call out the dedicated customers separately, they need direct outreach.

ben_s (infra): Note: machine reboots triggered by driver resets caused kubelet to mark nodes NotReady briefly which caused restart storms for sidecars. We're patching kubelet restart backoffs.

carmen (runtime): Follow-up: runtime logs show a pattern: IB port flap -> increased packet retransmits -> RDMA stack triggers DMA errors -> GPU driver sees I/O errors -> `nvidia-modedriver` resets contexts -> container crash. Sequence looks consistent across nodes.

alice_m (oncall): Good diagnostic thread. Short-term mitigation complete (traffic reroute + drains). Medium-term mitigation: vendor firmware patch or switch config change. Long-term: add router-level health check to take entire RDMA pool out earlier when link metrics degrade.

ops_pager: Handoff: @ben_s taking lead for infra; @carmen owns runtime changes and a post-incident patch. I'll update incident status to Investigating -> Mitigated -> Monitoring after we see 30m stable.

leo_sre: Handing off to night on-call in 40m: leaving this with ben_s and carmen. Key action items in handoff: 1) vendor firmware ticket #VND-8723, 2) full sysdump from one affected node (ib-node-12), 3) run `ibv_devinfo` on all hosts and collect counters, 4) ensure fallback pool autoscaling sustained.

ben_s (infra): I'll keep vendor engaged and schedule maintenance window if firmware rollback needed. Will also prepare an emergency config to disable RDMA on the switch if required.

carmen (runtime): I'll open a runtime patch PR to make RDMA optional at runtime and add a soft fail to route to CPU fallback if GPU resets detected frequently. Assigning postmortem to myself.

alice_m (oncall): Customer impact summary for incident record: region us-east-1, root cause suspected RDMA/InfiniBand link flaps causing device resets and CUDA driver failures, immediate mitigation: traffic reroute to non-RDMA pool + drain cordoned nodes, impact window: 1745001234 -> ongoing (mitigated at 1745004000), affected customers: Acme Analytics (dedicated), FinanceApp, ~4.8% global error spike, peak error rate 12% for some tenants.

devex_kitty: Drafted customer note and shared with CS. Will post after legal sign-off.

tim_sales: Thx. Please flag any customers that need credits/compensation.

ops_pager: Marking incident status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Will wait for 1hr stable metrics before closing.

alice_m (oncall): Handing off final on-call to @leo_sre; I've added the above notes to the incident ticket. If anyone sees a recurrence ping me.

leo_sre: Taking over. Thanks team. Will monitor metrics and vendor ticket. Postmortem timeline and action items to follow.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=MONITORING, severity=P1 -> P2, assigned=[ben_s, carmen], incident_id=INC-2025-1123

carmen (runtime): Post-incident: PR #457 to add RDMA disable flag and healthcheck submitted. Assigning rollout to canary tomorrow after firmware patch scheduled.

ben_s (infra): Collected sysdumps and posted to vendor ticket. Also scheduled a maintenance window for the switch at 02:00 UTC to test firmware rollback if vendor suggests.

leo_sre: Closing notes: add to postmortem: improve cross-layer alerts (IB port errors -> auto-evacuate RDMA pool), add per-pool kernel/device reset thresholds, and run chaos tests for RDMA degradation.

alice_m (oncall): Great work everyone. We'll reconvene for postmortem writeup. :thumbsup:
